events.title: Ten More Seconds at the Helm
events.summary: A while ago I fell into a classic development trap and convinced myself that the sluggishness in Ablahshikar’s close-range combat came from fire control. This was a bit like trying to fix a meal that just wasn’t very good. I tightened up the dials, made the turning increments smaller, and improved the tracking. events.title: Ablahshikar Crawled Out of a Picaresque Novel
events.summary: Ablahshikar crawled out of a picaresque novel called Traveller's Armamentarium. Originally, the sea of Thal-Drayem ferried only mercenaries and relics and the incredibly unlucky. Once sunken ships began growing organs, sea forts opened fire on one another, and crew members were casually stuffed into machinery, things spiraled out of control.
